name: 22201 · Arlington, VA
findings: ZIP 22201 (Arlington) has 316 nonprofit organizations. 151 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 132 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22201 (Arlington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
